name: Manfredi Marini
bio: Manfredi Marini is known as an actor. He is famous for his participation in Diciannove (2024) and For my own reason.

credits.title: Edo²
credits.overview: With another summer drawing to a close in a province of Northern Italy, Edoardo fights to regain control of a youth that feels far too small for him. When an online site appears to truly get him, offering a way to fill his emptiness, Edo seizes the chance to break free from the suffocating fear of never being enough.

credits.title: Mutrion
credits.overview: In a lagoon suspended in time, legend has it that sooner or later every inhabitant loses the toenail of their right big toe.

credits.title: For my own reasons
credits.overview: I'm twenty. I need to be scared of things.

credits.title: Nineteen
credits.overview: Leonardo, a 19-year-old student, leaves his hometown of Palermo to study economics in London. He soon grows restless and enrolls at the University of Siena to study literature before dropping out of school to study classics on his own.
